current.text: Goodwin re-signed with Phoenix on a 3-year, 19 million deal.
He comes off the bench. He is about the eighth or ninth man in the rotation and the fourth or fifth guard, behind Jalen Green, Devin Booker and Dillon Brooks.
He would have fantasy value at about 25 minutes a night. In his current bench role he does not.
Tier 9 point guard. He is a 16-team league player and only a possible option in 12-team leagues.
Phoenix has the best fantasy schedule in the league: 4 games in each of the three playoff weeks and the fewest back-to-backs.

durable.text: He is a strong rebounder for a guard and also gets steals. Last season he averaged about 5 rebounds and 1.5 steals in 22 minutes.

note: Yahoo ranks him 266th with a value of 0 USD, so he will not be among the 144 players drafted in our league. Leave him on waivers. His steals, guard rebounds and low turnovers are useful, but a projected 41% FG and 7.7 points hold him down while he plays bench minutes. Watch him early in the season: if an injury among Green, Booker or Brooks pushes him to about 25 minutes, he is a cheap pickup, and Phoenix's 4-4-4 playoff schedule adds a little late-season value.
